title: Introduction to Electrical Engineering
objectives:
An Introduction to basics of Electrical Engineering and its different fields and areas with presentations of leading
professors in their specific area, coupled with experiments in General Workshop.
syllabus:
Introduction to basics of Electrical Engineering
Introduction to Communication Science
Introduction to Electronics
Introduction to Bio-Electronics
Introduction to Digital Systems
Introduction to Power and Energy
Introduction to Control and Systems
textbooks:
1. J. Hom, "Hands – On Introduction to Electrical Engineering Lab Skills", MIT Course Number 6.091, Level:
Undergraduate, 2008.
